cases.assertion: No Git/source/Build; useful symbols and unresolved Build shown separately.

One invalid and one valid pair isolate failures; halves never available.
Identical byte sources merge; origins remain; no fingerprint change or extra demand.
Distinct content is conflict; no private/public/cache/unwind bypass.
Incomplete candidates never unique; contradictory candidates excluded before grouping.
Shared pair preserves independent role/Build/source policies and old sealed Builds.
Matched unknown fault module plus reliable owned caller can be Exact with full business coverage.
No business denominator means no Exact; usable symbols remain visible.
Role declaration creates new local-policy Run; history and other Workspace unchanged.
Duplicate DMP retains one Occurrence, distinct labels/times/origins; no Build inference.
Unrelated identity upload does not add demand/Run or change pair cache identity.
A-conflict-A creates newer recovery generation, including newer conflicting Run in flight.
Q7 retains business transient loss; Q16 only promotes strict business gain with preserved anchors and explicit system transient loss.
404 missing, malformed/integrity error, dependency/unknown loss never qualify as temporary system exception.
Ambiguous recursion, insufficient old trust and changed explanations yield exact incomparable reasons.
Verified withdrawal/recovery auditable; lower-quality correction allowed; expired DMP says withdrawn basis/cannot recompute.
All 205 across 2 Workspaces progress; concurrency <=2 global/1 per Workspace; overflow durable; no truncation.
Interleaved indexing/events/restart/duplicates/lease loss cannot lose demand or duplicate side effects or regress Current.
Initial plus 3 retries at 30/120/600 seconds; exhausted terminal until new evidence/manual request.
1.0 byte preservation, strict unknown rejection, 1.1 reading when writes disabled; minimum compatible rollback image pinned.
